citation: Hahn RG, Ljunggren S, Larsen F, et al. A simple intravenous glucose tolerance test for assessment of insulin sensitivity. Theoretical Biology & Medical Modelling. 2011.
protocol: IVGTT: glucose bolus 300 mg/kg (30% solution) over 60 s, 12 samples in 75 min; separate hyperinsulinaemic euglycaemic clamp
population: n=20 healthy volunteers, age 18-51 (mean 28) y, BMI 23.4+/-2.3, HbA1c 44 mmol/mol
note: Kinetic summary (volume of distribution, clearance) rather than per-time glucose. Baseline insulin reported as median (25th-75th percentile).
